claims.head: Special teams lean toward the Stars
claims.call: The Stars’ power play creates at least their usual 9.0 expected goals per 60.
claims.body: The Sharks’ penalty kill is near the bottom of the league, and the Stars’ power play is one of the best. Discipline matters more than usual for the Sharks tonight.

claims.head: Don’t blink and you still might miss the shots
claims.call: The game’s pace score is below 92, slower than either team’s usual.
claims.see: Fewer than 61 shots between them at 5-on-5, on goal or wide, which usually means 52 or fewer shots on goal on the scoreboard.
claims.body: The Sharks play some of the league’s slowest games, and so do the Stars. We think this one is even quieter than either team’s usual.

DAL.head: The matchup suits the Stars
DAL.body: Dallas has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage. The Sharks can make it interesting if they keep shots to a minimum.

SJS.head: The Sharks have a hill to climb
SJS.body: Dallas has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage. The Sharks’ best way through is keeping shots to a minimum.
